title: SEMANTIC VOTING: A SELF-EVALUATION-FREE APPROACH FOR EFFICIENT LLM SELF-IMPROVEMENT ON UNVERIFIABLE OPEN-ENDED TASKS

bias_targets.methodology: The paper does not directly quantify the bias, but indirectly evaluates its negative impact (overconfidence and reward hacking) by comparing the downstream translation and summarization performance of self-evaluating LLM baselines (which inherently suffer from self-preference bias) against the proposed self-evaluation-free semantic voting method.
